As an African i see your point of view. It is true that african skylines are changing there she is still struggle with the things you've mentioned. Poverty, (which i believe every continent has it's own level of poverty) conflicts, droughts and others. I believe each continent has it's own share of problems so this is nothing as an African I'm  ashamed of.
Public spaces well just like must of the countries there are those you would feel safe and those you will be warned to beware or not to go at all. But most Public spaces are safe on a normal day. Community is what matters most.
What i dread most is, finance wise, i believe most African countries are rich. They have money that can feed few generations, but corruption, favoritism, stinginess of some of her leaders makes her not move on. Majority of the money generated from people end up being embezzled and the rest not accounted for.(rich continue being rich and poor sinking further into poverty).

Someone once said, "If you ever want to finish a country, demoralise the economy, education and health sectors. "This started decades ago when Africa was gaining independence from her colonisers. Those boundaries i Honestly don't have a problem with them. I believe those who drew them did a good job. Atleast they establish territories and gave us a sense of belonging (i dont mean it wasn't their before though.) When Africans leaders took over from where the colonisers left, instead of immediately sitting to think of what next from there, they decided to first allocate themselves what was left of their countries and left the rest of nation behind and by the time they begin wanting to build the same nation they'd looted, the rest of the world is miles away. Worst still is they recycle themselves every election. The same wave of politicians and government people that were during independence is the same today(their protégé). It's when a tycoon dies and the family begin fighting for property instead of uniting to keep his legacy. Court proceedings starts with the 1st generation By the time the 3rd and 4th generation takes over, bankruptcy acquires their family name😅😅.

Much as the west is to blame, but i think Africa is her own enemy (sorry to say.) 
But I'm glad she is waking up I cant wait for a generation of her leaders who are not self centred, egoistic and all that makes a bad leader who instead of thinking with their stomachs will think with their subjects. That time is fast approaching.
